sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Hello, we've met before.
sentences.zh: 你好，我们以前见过。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Senator.
sentences.zh: 参议员。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, my colleagues and I traveled to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，我和同事们前往华盛顿特区

sentences.en: to meet with the Senate Minority Leader, who is now poised to become the Senate Majority Leader.
sentences.zh: 会见参议院少数党领袖，他现在即将成为参议院多数党领袖。

sentences.en: Chris, Rachel, Afim.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，雷切尔，阿菲姆。

sentences.en: Afim, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 阿菲姆，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Who is bringing in this rather elaborate contraption.
sentences.zh: 是谁搬来了这个相当复杂的玩意儿。

sentences.en: Well, I know New York Times is very pro-tech, so.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道《纽约时报》非常支持科技，所以……

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've been on quite a journey from the printing press.
sentences.zh: 从印刷机一路走来，我们经历了一段漫长的旅程。

sentences.en: Today, my conversation with Chuck Schumer about his role in Tuesday's sweeping Democratic victories, his plans to rein in President Trump,
sentences.zh: 今天，我与查克·舒默进行了对话，内容关于他在周二民主党压倒性胜利中所扮演的角色、他遏制特朗普总统的计划，

sentences.en: and the policy agenda that Democrats will pursue now that they're back in power.
sentences.zh: 以及民主党人在重新掌权后将推行的政策议程。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月6日，星期五。

sentences.en: I've given you the tour of this office, right?
sentences.zh: 我带你参观过这间办公室了吧？

sentences.en: Yes, but it...
sentences.zh: 是的，但是它……

sentences.en: That's the only Norman Rockwell of Lyndon Johnson.
sentences.zh: 那是唯一一幅诺曼·洛克威尔笔下的林登·约翰逊。

sentences.en: That is, I told you that one.
sentences.zh: 就是那个，我跟你说过那个的。

sentences.en: When the hooligans took over the Senate, took over the Senate...
sentences.zh: 当暴徒占领参议院，占领参议院的时候……

sentences.en: You mean January 6th?
sentences.zh: 你是说1月6日？

sentences.en: Yeah, on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 对，在1月6日。

sentences.en: Just describe what you're pointing to.
sentences.zh: 请描述一下你正在指的地方。

sentences.en: It's the tabulation of the electoral votes as they came...
sentences.zh: 那是选举人票送达时的唱票记录……

sentences.en: The certification of Joe Biden's victory.
sentences.zh: 那是对乔·拜登胜利的认证。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the hooligans we went, the leaders, were put in a secret place.
sentences.zh: 那些暴徒——我们去了，领导人们被带到了一个秘密地点。

sentences.en: Five o'clock, we gathered.
sentences.zh: 五点钟，我们集合了。

sentences.en: And this is McConnell and McCarthy, as well as Pelosi and me.
sentences.zh: 这就是麦康奈尔和麦卡锡，还有佩洛西和我。

sentences.en: And said, we're going back to the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 大家说，我们要回国会大厦。

sentences.en: We're not letting these bastards take our democracy away.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不让这群混蛋夺走我们的民主。

sentences.en: The police said, don't go.
sentences.zh: 警察说，不要去。

sentences.en: There may be people there.
sentences.zh: 那里可能有人。

sentences.en: We went, and at 3 a.m., that was completed, and it certified Joe Biden as president.
sentences.zh: 我们去了，凌晨3点，事情完成了，正式确认为乔·拜登当选总统。

sentences.en: They never made it...
sentences.zh: 他们从没能进到……

sentences.en: The rioters never made it into this office.
sentences.zh: 暴乱者从来没有进入过这间办公室。

sentences.en: Did the rioters make it into your office?
sentences.zh: 暴乱者进到你的办公室了吗？

sentences.en: But one of my police guards may have saved my life.
sentences.zh: 但我的一名警卫可能救了我的命。

sentences.en: We walk out the Senate door when they invade.
sentences.zh: 他们入侵时，我们走出了参议院大门。

sentences.en: We make a right turn.
sentences.zh: 我们向右转。

sentences.en: We open another door, and we're within 30 feet of them.
sentences.zh: 我们打开另一扇门，距离他们只有30英尺。

sentences.en: And one of them said, there's the big Jew.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人说，大犹太人就在那儿。

sentences.en: Let's get him.
sentences.zh: 抓住他。

sentences.en: And he blocked the door.
sentences.zh: 然后他挡住了门。

sentences.en: I went away, and he caught up, and here we are.
sentences.zh: 我走开了，他追了上来，我们就这样。

sentences.en: Still here.
sentences.zh: 依然在这里。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Let's sit.
sentences.zh: 我们坐下吧。

sentences.en: Well, Senator, thank you for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 参议员，谢谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thank you for letting us come into your office and...
sentences.zh: 谢谢你让我们来到你的办公室，并且……

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: ...outfit it with all this audio tech.
sentences.zh: ……在这里装上了所有这些音响设备。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: I just want to start with an observation.
sentences.zh: 我只想从一个观察开始谈起。

sentences.en: 18 months ago, you can correct me on the math, the situation for Democrats was extraordinarily bleak.
sentences.zh: 18个月前——你可以纠正我的数学计算——民主党人的处境极其黯淡。

sentences.en: Your party was arguably in the political wilderness.
sentences.zh: 可以说，你们的党派当时正处于政治荒漠之中。

sentences.en: You had lost the White House by a lot, lost the Senate.
sentences.zh: 你们在总统大选中惨败，还失去了参议院。

sentences.en: Democratic activists were calling for your head, arguing that you had been insufficiently combative in your approach to President Trump
sentences.zh: 民主党积极分子当时正要求你下台，争辩说你在应对特朗普总统

sentences.en: and the way he used power in the second term.
sentences.zh: 以及他在第二任期内如何行使权力时不够强硬。

sentences.en: Today, fast forward, Democrats have regained control of both chambers, and by a lot.
sentences.zh: 今天，快进到现在，民主党人重新掌控了两院，而且是以压倒性优势。

sentences.en: You have won a 54-seat majority in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 你们在参议院赢得了54席的多数地位。

sentences.en: It could end up being 56, depending on what happens in Mississippi and Alaska, and you are poised to be re-elected the Democratic leader.
sentences.zh: 根据密西西比州和阿拉斯加州的情况，最终甚至可能是56席，而且你即将再次当选民主党领袖。

sentences.en: That's quite a rollercoaster.
sentences.zh: 这真像坐过山车一样。

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean...
sentences.zh: 我是说……

sentences.en: Yeah, well, look, you're right.
sentences.zh: 对，好吧，看，你是对的。

sentences.en: When in January of 2025, right after we had lost the presidency, we had lost the Senate,
sentences.zh: 2025年1月，就在我们失去总统宝座、失去参议院之后不久，

sentences.en: I said we're going to take it back in 2026, and everyone rolled their eyes.
sentences.zh: 我说过我们要在2026年夺回来，当时所有人都翻了白眼。

sentences.en: Now, here we are.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们做到了。

sentences.en: It happened really for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 这主要归功于两个原因。

sentences.en: The first thing we did is we focused on what the American people wanted, not what we wanted, not what someone else wanted, but what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 我们做的第一件事是，我们关注美国人民想要什么，而不是我们想要什么，不是其他人想要什么，而是他们想要什么。

sentences.en: And we focused on the three issues they cared most about.
sentences.zh: 我们专注于他们最关心的三个议题。

sentences.en: Costs above all.
sentences.zh: 首当其冲的是生活成本。

sentences.en: The high cost of living.
sentences.zh: 高昂的生活成本。

sentences.en: Corruption.
sentences.zh: 腐败。

sentences.en: You had the most corrupt administration in, I think, in history.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你们当时面对的是历史上最腐败的政府。

sentences.en: And chaos.
sentences.zh: 还有混乱。

sentences.en: Chaos on the streets here.
sentences.zh: 这里街头的混乱。

sentences.en: Chaos at the war.
sentences.zh: 战争带来的混乱。

sentences.en: Right, you're talking about this.
sentences.zh: 没错，你说的就是这个。

sentences.en: Three Cs.
sentences.zh: 三个C。

sentences.en: Three Cs, yes.
sentences.zh: 三个C，是的。

sentences.en: And we were talking about that since a year ago, a year and a half ago.
sentences.zh: 我们从一年前、一年半前就开始谈论这个了。

sentences.en: And we were relentless.
sentences.zh: 而且我们毫不松懈。

sentences.en: The House and Senate, I worked with Hakeem on this as well.
sentences.zh: 众议院和参议院，我也与哈基姆合作过。

sentences.en: Jeffries.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里斯。

sentences.en: And my North Star was winning back the Senate, and that was number one.
sentences.zh: 我的北极星（指引）就是夺回参议院，那是第一位的。

sentences.en: Everything we did was focused on cost, chaos, and corruption, and relating it to people.
sentences.zh: 我们做的一切都专注于成本、混乱和腐败，并将其与民众联系起来。

sentences.en: The second thing we did, and really important, we recruited candidates in reddish and purple states.
sentences.zh: 我们做的第二件事，也是非常重要的一件事，就是在偏红和摇摆州招募候选人。

sentences.en: My goal has been for a decade since about 2006
sentences.zh: 十年来，大约从2006年开始，我的目标

sentences.en: is to expand the map.
sentences.zh: 就是扩大版图。

sentences.en: And so we looked at states where we might win where people never thought we'd win before.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们寻找那些我们可能获胜、而人们以前从未想过我们会赢的州。

sentences.en: When Trump did the tariffs and infected soybeans, we can win Iowa.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普搞关税战并重创大豆时，我们说我们能赢下爱荷华州。

sentences.en: When he fucked around with the northern border, we said we can- We can leave that out, Senator.
sentences.zh: 当他在北部边境胡闹时，我们说我们可以——参议员，我们可以把这个删掉。

sentences.en: Okay, if you want.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你想的话。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我无所谓。

sentences.en: I'm from Brooklyn, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我来自布鲁克林。

sentences.en: We looked at Maine and we looked at Alaska.
sentences.zh: 我们考察了缅因州和阿拉斯加州。

sentences.en: We can win there.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里能赢。

sentences.en: When Ohio went way overboard on these data centers, we said we can win there.
sentences.zh: 当俄亥俄州在这些数据中心上做得太过火时，我们说我们在那里能赢。

sentences.en: But second, and I got to give credit here, we recruited the best candidates, not who some political leader said we want them or this.
sentences.zh: 但其次，我必须在这里给予赞赏，我们招募了最优秀的候选人，而不是某些政治领袖说我们想要谁或者要这样的人。

sentences.en: We found candidates who were- fit their state.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了适合他们各自州的候选人。

sentences.en: And just every one of them was actually motivated by patriotism.
sentences.zh: 而且他们每一个人其实都是出于爱国主义动机。

sentences.en: Every single one.
sentences.zh: 每一个都是。

sentences.en: And so when I recruited
sentences.zh: 所以当我招募

sentences.en: Peltola and Turek
sentences.zh: 佩尔托拉和图雷克

sentences.en: in Iowa,
sentences.zh: 在爱荷华州，

sentences.en: Sherrod in Ohio,
sentences.zh: 谢罗德在俄亥俄州，

sentences.en: Cooper in North Carolina, it was motivated by patriotism.
sentences.zh: 库珀在北卡罗来纳州时，这都是出于爱国主义动机。

sentences.en: Can I tell you a quick story about Sherrod?
sentences.zh: 我能给你讲个关于谢罗德的简短故事吗？

sentences.en: So I flew out to Columbus three times to see Sherrod and Connie.
sentences.zh: 我曾三次飞往哥伦布市去看望谢罗德和康妮。

sentences.en: That's his wife.
sentences.zh: 那是他的妻子。

sentences.en: She's a Pulitzer Prize winner, but they're a team.
sentences.zh: 她得过普利策奖，但他们是一个团队。

sentences.en: Sherrod Brown had been out of office at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时谢罗德·布朗已经卸任公职。

sentences.en: He had just lost election the previous November by about three, four points.
sentences.zh: 他在前年11月的选举中刚刚以大约三到四个百分点的差距落败。

sentences.en: Presumably he was retired.
sentences.zh: 据推测他已经退休了。

sentences.en: Yes, he was retired.
sentences.zh: 是的，他退休了。

sentences.en: And that's just what I said to him.
sentences.zh: 我就是这么对他说过的。

sentences.en: I said on the third visit, when they hadn't said yes yet, I said to them,
sentences.zh: 我在第三次拜访时对他们说——当时他们还没答应——

sentences.en: Sherrod, Connie,
sentences.zh: 谢罗德，康妮，

sentences.en: look, you can have a great retirement.
sentences.zh: 听着，你们可以安享幸福的退休生活。

sentences.en: You've had a great legacy because you've had a terrific career.
sentences.zh: 你们已经有了伟大的历史遗产，因为你们有过非常了不起的职业生涯。

sentences.en: But if you don't run and you're the only one who can win in Ohio- You were recruiting him.
sentences.zh: 但如果你们不参选，而且你们又是唯一能在俄亥俄州获胜的人——你在招募他。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we lose the Senate by one vote.
sentences.zh: 我们以一票之差输掉参议院。

sentences.en: You're not going to enjoy your retirement that much.
sentences.zh: 你们的退休生活也不会那么惬意。

sentences.en: I really wanted to get him to run.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想让他参选。

sentences.en: You were working him over.
sentences.zh: 你在说服他。

sentences.en: I was, but he's my friend and, you know, we did it in a- You guilt tripped him.
sentences.zh: 我是说服了，但他我的朋友，你知道的，我们用了一种——你在对进行他道德绑架。

sentences.en: We did it in a-
sentences.zh: 我们用了一种——

sentences.en: Into running for U.S.
sentences.zh: 来竞选美国

sentences.en: Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议员。

sentences.en: In a friendly way.
sentences.zh: 以一种友好的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: A day later, they called up and said, we're running.
sentences.zh: 一天后，他们打电话来说，我们参选。

sentences.en: And, you know, I tried to recruit in places people never thought.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我试着在人们意想不到的地方招募人才。

sentences.en: Like where?
sentences.zh: 比如哪里？

sentences.en: Well, Scott,
sentences.zh: 嗯，斯科特，

sentences.en: Kaloum, in Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州的卡卢姆。

sentences.en: I was always eager
sentences.zh: 我一直渴望

sentences.en: to win in the South.
sentences.zh: 在南方取得胜利。

sentences.en: We had won in Georgia two years before.
sentences.zh: 两年前我们在佐治亚州赢过。

sentences.en: No one thought we could do that.
sentences.zh: 没人认为我们能做到这一点。

sentences.en: And Scott had been rejected
sentences.zh: 而且斯科特曾遭到拒绝

sentences.en: by the incumbent Senator,
sentences.zh: 来自现任参议员，

sentences.en: Hyde Smith.
sentences.zh: 海德·史密斯。

sentences.en: He had been nominated to be the first
sentences.zh: 他曾被提名成为一个世纪以来

sentences.en: African-American federal judge in Mississippi in a century.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州第一位非裔联邦法官。

sentences.en: And she blocked him.
sentences.zh: 而她阻止了他。

sentences.en: And I went to him and said, you got to run.
sentences.zh: 我去找他说，你必须参选。

sentences.en: I actually had, he and his father, I served them lunch in my house in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 我其实让他在我布鲁克林的家里，他和他的父亲，我请他们吃了午饭。

sentences.en: And, you know, they haven't declared his election at this point, but they're counting the votes.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们目前还没宣布选举结果，但他们正在统计选票。

sentences.en: He's ahead by 1700.
sentences.zh: 他领先1700票。

sentences.en: A lot of the remaining votes are provisional ballots, which usually go Democratic.
sentences.zh: 很多剩下的选票是临时选票，通常会投给民主党。

sentences.en: And he may make history and we are AC.
sentences.zh: 他可能会创造历史，而我们是AC。

sentences.en: You had a few misfires.
sentences.zh: 你遭遇了几次失利。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If you're bringing up recruitment.
sentences.zh: 如果你要提起人才招募的话。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You wanted Janet Mills, the governor of Maine, to be the nominee.
sentences.zh: 你希望缅因州州长珍妮特·米尔斯成为候选人。

sentences.en: The Democratic primary voters in Maine did not want that.
sentences.zh: 缅因州的民主党初选选民并不这么想。

sentences.en: Same with Haley Stevens in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州的黑莉·史蒂文斯也是如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, in the overall math, do you feel good about your recruitment or do you have some regrets?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从整体计算来看，你对你的招募工作感到满意，还是有一些遗憾？

sentences.en: And look, no, I feel very good about it.
sentences.zh: 听着，不，我对此感到非常满意。

sentences.en: You don't even regret
sentences.zh: 你现在甚至都不后悔

sentences.en: Haley Stevens now?
sentences.zh: 黑莉·史蒂文斯了吗？

sentences.en: No, the bottom line is...
